schema.title: JSON schema for Visual Studio's file nesting feature

description:
The nesting configuration is not a root file, so it will inherit any higher‑level settings. It defines a single set of dependent‑file providers. An empty *addedExtension* section is included, indicating that files with an additional extension should be grouped under the base file but no specific extensions are listed.

For *pathSegment* rules, any file ending with “.min” should be nested under the same file without that segment, and existing segment‑based rules are completely removed. Under *extensionToExtension*, JavaScript files (“.js”) are to be nested under their TypeScript counterparts (“.ts”), and CSS files (“.css”) under SCSS files (“.scss”). Mapping from source‑map files (“.map”) to JavaScript files (“.js”) is explicitly removed. The *fileToFile* section adds two name‑based nestings: “README.md” should appear under “README”, and “index.html” under “index”; all other file‑to‑file rules are cleared. In the *fileSuffixToExtension* settings, any file with the suffix “min” is grouped under both “.js” and “.css” files, a wildcard entry nests any other suffixed files under “.txt”, and the mapping from the “bak” suffix to “.old” is removed. Finally, the *allExtensions* rule adds a greedy mapping that brings every “.config” and “.json” file under a generic wildcard parent, while all previously defined all‑extension rules are removed.
